definitions: Move or cause to move in a specified direction.
Go past or across; leave behind or on one side.
Change from one state or condition to another.
Succeed in an examination, test, or other assessment.
Transfer something to someone, especially by handing it to them.
Be approved or adopted, especially by a parliament or committee.
examples: He passed the ball to his teammate.
The car passed us on the motorway.
The weather passed from sunny to cloudy.
The new law was passed by Parliament.
